title: Modal / dynamic / harmonic qualification contract
policy: A case marked READY is executable evidence, not qualification by itself.

requirements.phenomenon: Generalized eigenvalue solution and mode quality
requirements.domain: Supported sparse/modal models with documented constraints and mass matrix
requirements.justification: 1e-7 is the existing modal residual contract; frequency and mode acceptance remain reference-specific.

requirements.domain: At least coarse, medium and fine compatible meshes
requirements.justification: Existing family-specific studies use a one-percent final adjacent-level band, but no repository-wide Owner policy is approved; Owner decision is required before PASS.
requirements.policy_note: Proposal only: retain full tracked-mode sequence; exclude rigid-body modes and mode crossings from this metric.

requirements.phenomenon: Newmark transient response and residual control
requirements.domain: Supported Newmark configurations; beta/gamma and time step recorded per case
requirements.justification: The residual failure tolerance and existing dynamic benchmark energy policy are reused without relaxation.

requirements.domain: At least three time steps in a common physical time interval
requirements.justification: Existing dynamic studies use a one-percent final adjacent-level band, but no general-purpose temporal policy is approved in the current gate contract.
requirements.policy_note: Proposal only: same physical interval, load history and compatible output times are required; all adjacent errors remain diagnostic.

requirements.domain: Supported direct-frequency harmonic models; damping and frequency list recorded
requirements.justification: The existing harmonic residual contract and zero-frequency benchmark criterion are retained.

requirements.domain: At least coarse and refined frequency grids, with resonance handling documented
requirements.justification: Existing harmonic refinement evidence supports a one-percent final-grid amplitude proposal, but no common peak/phase policy is approved for all supported models.
requirements.policy_note: Proposal only: local sampling is required near resonance; do not apply across changed damping/materials or singular exact resonance.
